dedupe_keys.name: paer potential renewable energy acceleration areas for solar pv and wind in portugal lneg 2024

description: The potential renewable energy acceleration areas (PAER) dataset was produced by LNEG for the GTAER working group set up by Despacho 11912/2023 of 23 November 2023 to define Renewable Energy Acceleration Areas in Portugal. It consolidates earlier work identifying areas of lower sensitivity for solar photovoltaic and wind electricity production units and assesses their implementation potential. Areas were identified under five scenarios, depending on whether three constraints are excluded: porous aquifers of the western edge and the Tagus-Sado basin, distance from residential and mixed-use built fabric, and available National Agricultural and Ecological Reserve land. The results reflect the situation in February and March 2024. The areas feed the definition of future preferred acceleration areas, where licensing will be simplified, but are not the formal designation, and projects may still be licensed elsewhere. The data are available online as a WMS service and through the LNEG geoportal open data page under CC BY 4.0; the catalogue entry was updated on 25 September 2026. Coverage is Portugal. Caveats: texts are in Portuguese and the areas are candidate zones, not legal designations. Simulation uses are land available for new solar and wind capacity in national capacity expansion and siting models.
